title: SosResource lacks OSCORE authentication check
description: SosResource.render_post (line 70) and render_delete (line 101) do not verify OSCORE protection via request.opt.object_security, unlike HandoffResource (line 81) which follows the codebase pattern for security-sensitive resources. Unauthenticated POST allows attackers to trigger false SOS alerts causing DoS. Unauthenticated DELETE allows attackers to cancel legitimate emergency alerts, a safety hazard in real emergencies. Add require_oscore parameter and check at lines 71 and 102.
close_reason: Fixed: Added require_oscore parameter to SosResource.__init__ (defaults True), and added OSCORE authentication checks at the start of render_post and render_delete methods. Unauthenticated requests now return 4.01 Unauthorized, matching HandoffResource and RollcallResource patterns.
